identities.owner: spawn-start identities (PID + token); strangers share the PID with a foreign token; bare PIDs never authority
identities.suite: bounded local OS controls only (/bin/sh, exec-form sleepers, t.TempDir journals/targets); no live suite, no network
identities.observer: journal replay (Pending order) + signal-0 liveness probes + dev/ino path identity

retained_facets: death with intact target never authorizes signal/deletion/pass (owner-mismatch refusal; target bytes intact; foreign sleeper alive; journal unadvanced)
old unknown schema refuses everything (scan marker 99/empty/oversize; proof schema; receipt schema 99 fails closed to incomplete)
replaced directory refuses (vanished, symlink-swap, dev/ino mismatch; replacement preserved; remover never called)
active foreign process refuses with its own reason (foreign-process-live; probe still true after scan)
incomplete liveness proof refuses (missing proof, dead/foreign/unverifiable process, naming gaps, malformed op)
later safe cleanup preserves the old incomplete outcome (stranger + scan-denied refusals untouched, then owner cleanup Complete+Removed with outcome incomplete, journal closed, receipt round-trips)
bounded drain (stop-admission gate, SIGTERM + grace + abort escalation, PID order, cap refuses with remainder untouched, ignored-TERM escalates, empty/invalid cases)
owner-only cleanup (VerifyAuthority identity+path gates, scan decision gate, spy remover never called on refusal, prior preserved verbatim in all three outcomes, receipt always returned)
scan-to-cleanup wiring across packages (stranger scan refuses, owner scan allows, safe cleanup completes)

integrator_fixes: LoadFile now enforces the size bound during the read (LimitReader) instead of reading the whole file first, so a hostile oversized receipt cannot exhaust memory before rejection

gate/drain docs now state the latch stops cooperating admitters only (process.Owner.Spawn does not consult the gate); a racing spawner yields an incomplete-drain report, never a silent partial success
oversize schema-marker pin (>64 bytes refuses unknown-schema; branch was untested)
long-reason truncation pin (scan-denial reasons cap at 256 bytes)
path-without-reservation pin (non-empty target against a pathless reservation refuses replaced-path without calling the remover)
close-walk-from-live pin (safe cleanup of a live operation lands closed with prior preserved)
failed-removal-retry pin (a failed removal stays failed-state yet a later working remover proceeds; terminal failed state kept, history not rewritten)
resource_and_cleanup_receipts: journals/targets/leases in t.TempDir; every live-child test defers Abort and asserts Live()==0; distinct sleep markers per test; ps sweeps show no strays
no repo writes outside owned P11 paths
reviewer_disposition: integrator accepted: read all 8 source files and all 7 test files in full (2081 lines); verified the journal contracts underneath (VerifyAuthority is read-only, terminal states excluded from Pending, failed-state retry legal); independently re-ran vet/tests/race plus the deps-confinement check. Fixed 1 robustness gap (unbounded receipt read), 2 doc overreaches (gate scope), and added 4 test pins for untested branches. The deadPID helper's ms-scale PID-reuse window was considered and kept: replacing it with an impossible PID would trade real dead-process coverage for theoretical determinism. Independent final review deferred to Z06.
limitations: path identity is dev/ino at scan/cleanup time: a delete-and-recreate that reuses the inode inside the window would compare equal (inherent to path identity without an open-fd pin; scan and cleanup are not atomic)

scan decisions are advisory inputs to Perform (Allow/DenyReason fields), not capabilities: the hard gates are VerifyAuthority plus the caller's own scan; a caller that lies to itself about Allow bypasses only its own scan
receipt files carry no integrity seal: a tampered file can claim any outcome, so receipts are evidence, never authority (PriorFromFile documents that the outcome alone authorizes nothing)
a wedged child costs Abort's internal reap bound per child during drain escalation (finite, not grace-bounded)
closeJournal Advance errors stop the walk silently: the receipt still reports Complete when the target is gone (truthful about the target; the journal state stays observable via Lookup)
